name: Complete pc-Minor Basis for Convex-Treelike Partial Cubes
statement: A finite partial cube belongs to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$ if and only if it has no pc-minor in $\{Q_n^{--}:n\geq3\}\cup\mathcal O_{\mathrm{per}}^{\mathrm{amp}}$. These are precisely all pc-minimal nontrivial periphery-free partial cubes. The ample part is equivalently the collection of two-layer lifts whose layers and contraction belong to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$ and whose all-retained state is the unique state preserving every oriented section defect.
proof: A graph lies outside $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$ exactly when it has a nontrivial periphery-free pc-minor; finite descent yields a pc-minimal one. If such an obstruction is nonample, the complete ample-class basis supplies a pc-minor $Q_n^{--}$, and minimality forces equality. Every remaining obstruction is ample.
comments: The basis is infinite. The ample part has an exact coordinate-state predicate and many explicit members, but no finite parametrization is claimed.
